# Zaid Hossain

> Websites and automations for small businesses. I build websites that bring customers in, and systems that answer your calls, reply to messages and refill cancelled spots, so more customers don't mean more hours.

## What I build

- Websites: a site with one clear job, getting customers to call, book or buy.
- Automations: the replies, follow-ups and record-keeping each new customer creates, running on their own.

## How it works

1. Discovery & Scope: a call about where your time goes and where customers slip away.
2. Plan & Design: you see the plan before anything is built.
3. Build & Connect: built in small working pieces. The code is yours from day one.
4. Test & Ship: tested and put live.
5. Handover & Support.
